blocks.text:
'You will come back? Really? After you become a knight?'
'It's a promise then. We'll wait for you to come home, showered in glory, and then we'll spread the word that our town is the home of the Justyna, the knight!'
My... home.
Careful.
Sorry.
I've never seen you in the village. Are you from outside?
I was born here. Then I went to Kawalerielki.
Kawalerielki! Are you a knight?
You must be! Your armor looks much better than the wooden stuff Hubert makes.
Can I see your crossbow?
Millen! Stop bothering people!
I'm sorry, the boy's been reading too many knight novels lately. The questions flow nonstop when he meets someone from out of town.
Wait, is it just me... or do you look familiar...?
Aunt Danka.
Justyna...? You're really back... oh, I suppose it's Fartooth Knight now.
We saw the news about your title. Everyone's happy for you.
You remember old Cole? He saves clippings of every headline about you on his wall.
He opens a bottle whenever you win a competition—probably just an excuse for him to drink more.
But...
You got sick... we heard about it on the news. Everyone in the village is worried.
It's under control.
Very good, very good.
What's that in your hand, Millen?
The knight's quiver.
Don't touch that!
Err, I mean... give it back to Fartooth Knight. It's very expensive.
It's dangerous, even if it won't hurt you.
I'm sorry, I should be more considerate.
Do you want to sit a spell, Fartooth Knight? We've all missed you. I'll just need to give them a heads-up... to prepare properly.
What are you standing there for, Fartooth?
We have to count the Infected after the evacuation.
...Group Two, all accounted for.
(When did she count them? She was definitely daydreaming.)
Has anyone seen Zola? Where did she go?
Is something wrong, Mr. Farone?
I think Zola went out to take a look at the new camp, but she's not back yet.
Did anyone see her when we moved over from Residential Sector 9?
I wasn't paying attention... it was still dark, and I was leading the way for a villager with a bad leg...
Don't worry, we'll find her, but we need to narrow down the area. There are a lot of buildings between the two sectors.
Sona...
I may know where the girl went.
The day before...
Hello again, friends.
How many times has it been in the last six months?
This is the fourth.
It's been a long stay in this abandoned industrial area, all things considered. Three full months since the last evacuation.

I still remember that time the Armorless Union came knocking just a few days after we settled down. Since then, I've kept my stuff down to what I can fit in a couple of bags, ready to leave at a moment's notice.
Sorry, folks. Sona's working to find a place you can stay for the long haul.
It's not your fault. It's all thanks to Pinus Sylvestris that we're still able to stay in Kawalerielki at all. Besides, where can a bunch of Infected go?
We got used to it when we wandered the edge of the nomadic plate. But Zola didn't like it, and even had a fight with Mr. Farone over it in the morning.
The General Chamber of Commerce crackdown is intensifying. Not just the commercial plates; the residential areas aren't safe anymore.
Armorless Union patrols have been spotted on the streets nearby. Not many, but it's a warning sign.
I say we pound 'em flat and show those empty suits this is Pinus Sylvestris turf.
And give them an excuse to blow up our factory while we're short-handed?
What do you think, Justyna?
...It's just an abandoned factory.
That's right! We'll find another place nearby—
...It's not home.
Their home was destroyed in a Catastrophe. They should move to a safer place, so that more may live.
Fartooth!
We don't have what it takes to butt heads with the GCC directly, not yet. Maybe someday we'll have our own plate, and every Infected in Kawalerielki will have a home to go back.
We are setting out first thing tomorrow morning. Ashley and I know the routes best, so we'll lead the pack. Iwona, you clear any obstacles. Justyna, you're on recon duty.
As for tonight—
I'll keep watch.
Is that...?
...Zola?
Those people in black weren't here in this alley a few days ago...
No, I'll be late if I take any more detours. I'll have to...
What are you doing here?
Mmph—
Don't leave the camp at night. It's dangerous.
Justyna...
I'll take you back.
No, no! Rita's waiting for me!
Rita?
Don't tell Mr. Farone, please. He'll be mad if he finds out I'm friends with a kid from the residential district.
But Rita's a good girl, really. She doesn't care about my sickness, she says I'm good at drawing...
Why do we have to move all the time, Justyna?
I am the same as everybody else when I wrap myself up. Nobody found out I was sick when Rita took me into a shop.
I don't want to move again...
After the village got destroyed, we drifted around the wilderness, slowly running out of food.
We were only able to get into Kawalerielki because Mr. Farone found Sona.
But we're still drifting. We just do it underground now.
I can barely remember the berries that grew on the trees of the village. I used to love them so much...
We wouldn't be like this if the village was still around.
Is there anywhere the Infected can go at all...?
Was your home destroyed by Catastrophe too?
No, that village has not faced a single Catastrophe in its entire history.
Sounds nice... where is it? Is it pretty?
It sits in the north, where the forest meets the plains.
It is... a beautiful place.
What's your hometown like, Justyna? Tell me all about it!
Maybe next time.
Who's there?
A third patrol?
Come in, patrol... come in... do you require backup...?
We need to move.
But...
But I haven't said goodbye to Rita yet...
I told her not to play with uninfected children!
There are no kids Zola's age in the camp. She's lonely.
The Armorless Union doesn't care that she's a child.
She's Infected. To them, young doesn't mean innocent; it just means easier cleanup.
Justyna. How sure are you about Zola?
...I can't be sure.
We ruffled feathers when we got out of Sector 9. The Armorless Union is probably watching the warehouse right now. Scouts, troopers... they'll be out in force.
It's not just this district that we have to protect. There's another group of refugees who just arrived at the outskirts of Kawalerielki today, waiting for our escort.
I thought I heard something in that storage room. Should we check it out?
In an abandoned warehouse like this, there're bound to be critters crawling around. I'm not going in there.
The storage room... that's where Zola was drawing her pictures!
Green... red stripes...
Yes, yes... and yellow, just like her eyes.
There's a pattern on her quiver, and shiny bolts inside.
Justyna's an amazing shot... one bolt, and all the bad guys in black scatter...
No need to be scared... no need to be scared...
The scope's in the wrong place.
I couldn't aim properly if it were so far forward.
Justyna!
I... I'm so sorry... I just wanted to get the parting gift I made for Rita...
I wanted to keep it... even if I couldn't give it to her...
You'll meet again.
Let's get out of here. Can you walk?
I twisted my ankle when I came in... I'm sorry... I'm so scared...
It's okay. No need to apologize.
Close your eyes, Zola.
But...
Yesterday, you asked me what my hometown was like.
Close your eyes, and I'll tell you all about it.
Wh-What's that sound?!
A-Are you okay, Justyna?
I'm fine. Keep your eyes shut.
The bug lands on a wheat stalk. The harvest sickle swings, and it dives into the soil.
And the wind.
The melody on the wind is the little tune that Uncle Cole liked to play.
That's my... home.
(The reinforcements came quickly. It's going to be hard to get through the front door carrying Zola...)
What was that sound?
We're under attack! This is where the Infected knights have been harboring the refugees. Be on your guard!
(Come on, Justyna... you've faced down multiple enemies in the tourneys... you can think of something...)
...Wild Mane?
So many assassins to guard one abandoned warehouse. Since when is the GCC in the business of bleeding money?
You think you can take us all by yourself?
Hmph, one more helper won't make a difference—
You're rushing too far ahead, Wild Mane!
That's what being a lancer is all about—charging into the fray and messing up enemy formations! Standard tactics.
Then what's the point of making a plan?
Got to adapt to change.
Ashley means you're too far from the formation for her to protect you with her shield.
That's not what I said!
We're here to get Justyna, aren't we? Where is she?
There.
You were right, Justyna. You found Zola.
Thanks... all of you.
You're welcome.
The rest of the knights are off to help our new friends. We were always going to hold back here.
I just didn't expect you to charge even faster than me.
We haven't talked much, but I think I like you!
More guys coming in, eleven o'clock and two o'clock.
Ashley—
They're too scattered. I don't have enough ammo left.
Leave it to me.
They have a sniper! Form up, don't get picked off!
Thanks.
Good job.
Front door's open. All the Armorless Union assassins in the factory are down.
Communications equipment's dealt with. There won't be any more reinforcements for a while.
Something isn't right.
Zola? You can open your eyes now. A pity you missed the fight, but you are too young for this.
The wind isn't right.
Justyna? What's the matter?
Argh—
Phew, that was close.
Didn't see that sniper up there.
How'd you spot him, Justyna?
I couldn't hear the sound of the wind.
What?
Well... there's a window there. Wind affects the trajectory of a projectile.
I'm guessing you didn't get it either.
You'll get used to the way Justyna talks soon enough.
Zola.
Justyna...
It's safe now.
Let's go home.
'Beep beep'—
What's that?
(Inquisitive beeping)
Wild Mane's... pet?
(Joyous beeping)
(Cheerful beeping)
Hey, stop! You'll wake everyone up!
Where's the switch?
The switch is behind the plate.
...Thanks.
I wouldn't recommend shutting her off, though. Justice Knight gets lonely when she can't get a signal around her.
You like to be with people, don't you?
(Joyous beeping)
Hey, Justyna... what's that sound? I've never heard it before...
It's my flute.
You play the flute?
Oh... I see.
You had Justice put out a call because you wanted an audience, didn't you?
Well, you've found one. I don't know much about music, but I'm a great listener.
Go ahead and play, Fartooth Knight.
You just wanted to get in on the action.
Greynuty?
Did Justice wake you up too?
No, YOU woke me up.
You should thank me, then. Justyna is putting on a show.
Don't pressure her... is that a flute?
I used to live near an old woman with a bad leg. I could hear her playing in her house, one of these hand-made flutes.
Now I'm starting to miss the traditional melodies from back in the day.
What's that? An attic party, and I wasn't invited?
And there I was, thinking I was giving you a bit more sleep after that rescue operation.
You got woken up too?
I was thinking about Zola.
Iwona's right. We can't hide underground forever.
People have gotten so used to the nomadic life that they're beginning to forget even the Infected deserve to have a home.
Come down and hear out my new idea, since you're up anyway.
Sure.
What about the show?
Maybe next time, Iwona.
I'll play you a song from home.
